There are two systems of justice. The one I call transactional justice and the other punitive justice.

The transactional justice systems serves the interest of the elite class. It’s whenever you hear a household name corporation settling a lawsuit for what a regular person would face significant prison time.

For example, in its defense against illegal monopoly charges, Apple literally lied in court and tried to hide evidence from the judge. Anyone else would be criminally charged for lying under oath. But not anyone at Apple ever will because Tim Cook is the best buddies with President of the United States Donald Trump, literally gifting him golden plaques live on national television.
